integrity: An exact labeled-set distributional identity is proved analytically using forbidden-set survival and finite Möbius inversion; the independent exact-rational program supplies supplemental finite checks. Originality relative to possibly unindexed literature is not independently certified.
limitations: Finite discrete-time complete graphs with identical holding parameter and independent uniform stationary starts; no general-graph or whole-trajectory claim. A simple path is an explicit boundary to allocation invariance.
title: Exact seed-augmentation law for stationary multiwalk ranges on complete graphs
